title: Threat Protection with Microsoft Defender XDR

header.html: Describe Microsoft Defender XDR services; Describe Microsoft Defender for Office 365; Describe Microsoft Defender for Endpoint; Describe Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps; Describe Microsoft Defender for Identity; Describe Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management; Describe Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence; Describe the Microsoft Defender portal
the official SC-900 study guide, skills measured as of October 21, 2026

html:
1Defender XDR: the idea

Extended detection and response (XDR) joins signals from many protection areas so related attacks appear as one incident. Microsoft Defender XDR (formerly Microsoft 365 Defender) combines these products:

Product Protects
Defender for Office 365 Email and collaboration (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
Defender for Endpoint Devices (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android)
Defender for Identity On-premises Active Directory identities and signals
Defender for Cloud Apps Cloud apps (a CASB), including shadow IT
Microsoft Entra ID Protection Identity risk signals
Defender Vulnerability Management Weaknesses in devices and apps

Core XDR features: correlated incidents, automatic attack disruption, advanced hunting, and automated investigation and response (AIR).

Exam tip

. XDR = one incident across email, endpoints, identities and apps. Old name: Microsoft 365 Defender. Do not mix up Defender XDR (threat protection for workplace) and Defender for Cloud (Azure and multicloud workloads).

2Defender for Office 365

Protects email and collaboration against phishing, malware, business email compromise and malicious links and attachments.

Feature Meaning
Safe Links Checks links when clicked (time of click)
Safe Attachments Opens attachments in a sandbox before delivery
Anti-phishing Detects impersonation and spoofing, using machine learning
Attack simulation training Simulated phishing to train users
Threat Explorer and automated investigation Investigate and remediate threats

3Defender for Endpoint

An enterprise endpoint security platform that prevents, detects, investigates and responds to threats on devices.

Capability Meaning
Next-generation protection Antivirus and antimalware
Endpoint detection and response (EDR) Detects advanced attacks and shows the attack story
Attack surface reduction Rules that block risky behavior
Automated investigation and remediation Fixes threats automatically
Device isolation Cut an infected device off the network
Threat and vulnerability information Links to Defender Vulnerability Management

4Defender for Cloud Apps

A cloud access security broker (CASB) that gives visibility and control over cloud apps and data.

Capability Meaning
Cloud Discovery Finds apps in use, including shadow IT, and rates their risk
Information protection Finds and protects sensitive data in cloud apps
Threat protection Detects anomalous behavior and compromised accounts
Policies and Conditional Access App Control Real-time session monitoring and limits
App connectors Connect to apps through APIs
Exam tip

. Shadow IT (unsanctioned cloud apps) = Defender for Cloud Apps / CASB / Cloud Discovery.

5Defender for Identity

Uses signals from on-premises Active Directory (domain controllers) to detect compromised identities and advanced threats, such as pass-the-hash, reconnaissance, lateral movement and privilege escalation. It uses sensors installed on domain controllers.

Exam tip

. On-premises AD attacks and lateral movement = Defender for Identity. Cloud sign-in risk = Entra ID Protection.

6Defender Vulnerability Management

Continuously discovers, prioritizes and helps remediate vulnerabilities and misconfigurations across devices, applications and certificates, with risk-based prioritization, a software inventory, security baselines and remediation tracking. It is included in Defender for Endpoint (full capabilities as an add-on). [Verify live]

7Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence

Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence (Defender TI) gives analysts insight into threat actors, infrastructure and tactics (Microsoft Threat Intelligence), helping them investigate and understand attackers. Microsoft's threat intelligence also feeds all Defender products.

8The Microsoft Defender portal

The Microsoft Defender portal (security.microsoft.com) is the single place to work with XDR products: incidents and alerts, hunting, actions and submissions, threat intelligence, reports, and secure score for Microsoft 365. It now also hosts Microsoft Sentinel (unified security operations). [Verify live]

9Exam Q&A

9.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Fabrikam Outdoors wants to detonate email attachments in a sandbox before they reach users. Which feature does this?

  • AAzure Bastion for remote desktop sessions to VMs
  • BSmart lockout for repeated failed sign-ins by attackers
  • CSafe Attachments in Defender for Office 365
  • DDefender for Key Vault alerts on secret access
Show the answer

Answer: C. Safe Attachments opens attachments in a sandbox before delivery.

S2An administrator needs to find which unsanctioned cloud apps employees use. Which product helps?

  • ADefender for Identity on domain controllers
  • BAzure Firewall for network filtering
  • CDefender for Cloud Apps
  • DKey Vault for secrets and keys
Show the answer

Answer: C. Cloud Discovery in Defender for Cloud Apps finds shadow IT.

S3Which product detects attacks such as pass-the-hash on on-premises Active Directory?

  • ADefender for Identity
  • BDefender for Office 365
  • CDefender Vulnerability Management
  • DAzure DDoS Protection
Show the answer

Answer: A. Defender for Identity monitors domain controllers for identity threats.

S4Which capability lets an administrator isolate an infected laptop from the network?

  • ADefender for Cloud Apps
  • BDefender for Endpoint
  • CAccess reviews
  • DSensitivity labels
Show the answer

Answer: B. Defender for Endpoint can isolate devices.

S5What was Microsoft Defender XDR called before?

  • AAzure Security Center
  • BCloud App Security
  • CMicrosoft 365 Defender
  • DAzure AD
Show the answer

Answer: C. Microsoft 365 Defender was renamed Microsoft Defender XDR.

S6Which capability prioritizes software weaknesses on devices by risk?

  • ASafe Links for URLs in email and Office files
  • BCloud Discovery of unsanctioned cloud apps
  • CPassword writeback to on-premises directories
  • DDefender Vulnerability Management
Show the answer

Answer: D. Defender Vulnerability Management discovers and prioritizes vulnerabilities.

9.2 Recall questions

R1What does XDR stand for?

Show the answer

Extended detection and response.

R2What does Safe Links do?

Show the answer

Checks links at the time of click.

R3What does CASB stand for?

Show the answer

Cloud access security broker.

R4Where does Defender for Identity get signals?

Show the answer

On-premises Active Directory domain controllers.

R5What is Defender Threat Intelligence for?

Show the answer

Insight into threat actors and their methods.

R6What is the Defender portal?

Show the answer

The single portal for XDR incidents, hunting and more.

10Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Defender XDR formerly Microsoft 365 Defender; Office 365, Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps combined into incidents
Office 365 Safe Links, Safe Attachments, anti-phishing, attack simulation
Endpoint antivirus, EDR, attack surface reduction, isolation
Cloud Apps CASB; Cloud Discovery; shadow IT
Identity on-premises AD sensors; pass-the-hash, lateral movement
Vulnerability Management and Threat Intelligence prioritize weaknesses; threat actor insight
Defender portal single place for incidents, hunting, reports; hosts Sentinel
